Original cutout identities, annotations, training overlap, matching rules and author detector/checkpoint remain unbound; descriptive connectome analyses stay calibration.

evidence.locator: Results: automated synapse identification and Extended Data Fig. 2b; Methods: Synapse detection and Synapse detection evaluation
evidence.supports: Reports F-score 0.83, precision 0.87, recall 0.78 and an aggregate evaluation over 16 independently expert-annotated cutouts; describes original detector/postprocessing.

target.description: Detect synaptic links and assign both partners in the original BANC EM evaluation cutouts; either incorrect partner is a source evaluation error.

dataset.description: Original BANC synapses_v2 evaluation images and 16 expert-annotated cutouts must be identified and version-pinned; the graph-edgelist release alone is not the detector evaluation dataset.

cohort.description: All 16 source cutouts, each 2×2×0.7 micrometres, sampled across the one-fly CNS; preserve their full regional coverage.

split.description: Recover the exact 16 evaluation cutout coordinates and their relationship to FAFB pretraining and the 721 additional BANC training labels. A new cutout split cannot inherit the published score.

inputs.description: Original aligned EM imagery at source detector resolution; expert annotations and assessment partner identities remain evaluator-owned.

preprocessing.description: Source uses 8×8×45 nm detection inputs, 16×16×45 nm output/assignment, removes objects below three voxels and merges identical assignments within 200 nm. Exact deployed model/configuration and evaluation matching settings remain unbound.

metric.description: Aggregate F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), with either partner incorrect counted as an error. Exact prediction-to-expert matching and ambiguity-adjudication rules must be frozen; precision/recall remain required diagnostics.

aggregation.description: Sum TP, FP and FN across all 16 original cutouts before computing overall precision, recall and F-score; do not substitute a mean of per-cutout F1 values.

comparison.primary_metric: Aggregate synaptic-link F1 on original 16 expert-annotated cutouts (ED Fig. 2b)

published_baseline.description: Source-reported overall F-score; precision 0.87 and recall 0.78 are separately reported. These rounded figures require original counts for exact candidate comparison.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Recover the original FAFB-pretrained/BANC-tuned detector and partner-assignment checkpoint, preprocessing and evaluation artifacts; no author rerun has been performed.

minimum_effect.rationale: Meaningful F1 gain must be justified against finite annotation counts, annotation ambiguity and regional variation; no universal margin or improvement inferred from rounded values.

uncertainty.method: No superiority rule is admitted until original evaluation identities and paired baseline outputs are recovered.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Evaluation cutout/region conditional on the single fly; synapses within a cutout are dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: Paired cutout-level baseline/candidate counts and dependence-aware uncertainty are needed; sixteen cutouts do not establish independent-animal replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact original 16 cutouts, annotations, partner identities, training/evaluation separation and matching rules.
Use identical source inputs and original task; a new set of regions, edited gold labels or easier partner-detection target is not a paper win.
Compare aggregate counts with a verified author baseline and the reported 0.83 F-score, retaining precision/recall and all per-cutout results.
Freeze candidate thresholds and all postprocessing before final evaluation; predeclare effect, uncertainty and equal access/resource budgets.
Graph reconstruction/runtime and separate neurotransmitter-classification scores cannot replace this detection endpoint.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparator is distinct from an author rerun and from current SOTA; no current-SOTA comparison was verified.

episode.improvement_loop: After original split recovery, expose only source-authorized training/development imagery and feedback; keep the original evaluation annotations protected.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze detector, partner assignment, checkpoint, thresholds and postprocessing before any final-cutout scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate every original cutout with original matching rules and aggregate TP/FP/FN; compare to source/author baselines under predeclared effect and uncertainty criteria.
episode.baseline_policy: Published F-score, exact source counts and reproduced author detector are distinct. Synapses_v3 is not silently substituted for the original v2 result; neurotransmitter prediction remains a separate source task.

blocking_issues: Original cutout coordinates, immutable expert annotations and training overlap have not been recovered.
Original detector/assignment checkpoints, full evaluation matching/adjudication code and raw baseline counts remain unbound.
No validated working evaluator, meaningful margin, uncertainty admission or concrete episode budgets exist for the selected route.

legacy.notes: Preserve graph organization/influence, resource comparisons and all historic source materials as calibration/engineering artifacts. Source-native current objective is the original ED2b synapse-detection task; existing graph runtime is not its evaluator.
